clips.title: The story
paras: In Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil turns dark voodoo against the Horde's enemies. The Darkspear troll mystic lives in a cave in the southern Stonetalon Mountains and is a longtime comrade of Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan.

In a cave east of Malaka'jin, Jin'Zil practices the ancient arts of jungle trolls, far from his tribe's coastal home. Bubbling cauldrons and captive prisoners fill his cavern. He gathers exotic reagents from the Stonetalon crags, weaving blessings and curses to defend the Horde's mountain camp.

Jin'Zil is an old friend of senior Horde scouts Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan. Darsok leads frontline skirmishes against night elves and harpies. Jin'Zil fights the war through spirit and alchemy, using forest magic and volatile voodoo to weaken threats before they reach the camp gates.
